rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out; 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no Microsoft, Nvidia or Asus logos (text names only; crop the RTX Spark badge out of A). '1,000 vents' always with 'Microsoft says'. Whenever the Asus price is shown, show '64 GB' with it (half the memory).
official_clips: Microsoft device page MP4s (assets_sources.md): Petaflop slide1 (mobile), AI-Compute slide3 (mobile) — ≤ 3 s each, muted, ≤ 20 % total
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the numbers; blush for THE CATCH; mint for SPEC
new_objects: ventGrid (square grid of rounded holes, `lit` rows 0–1 light up with a glow, `count` label; reuse for speaker grilles/vents), paramCloud (cluster of nodes+links that grows with `t`, `label` under it; reuse for AI model size / neural nets) — add each to render/kit/OBJECTS.md. Reuse: priceTag, questionStamp, miniPc, chipDie, gauge, counter, ramStick, coreGrid, gpuCard, thermometer, monitorOutline, scale, pill, crossMark, scoreTable.
